content:
I have opened a small PR #38811 adding Submodule.mkQL, the bundled continuous linear mao version of Submodule.mkQ, paralleling the existing Submodule.subtypeL. Two related lemmas are added at the same time: Submodule.continuous_mkQ and Submodule.isQuotientMap_mkQL.

The motivation comes from work on PR #38547 (topological complements of submodules), where reasoning about continuity of maps factoring through a quotient repeatedly wanted the bundled M →L[R] M ⧸ p rather than the unbundled mkQ. Surprisingly, this didn't seem to exist already - happy to be corrected if I missed it.
@Anatole Dedecker is this what you had in mind for what this should look like?
